answer: Defector bounties: each agent posts a bond, and anyone who proves two accounts share one operator, say a leaked signing key or a matching pigment of log metadata, claims both bonds. A sybil farm then sits on a knife ridge: every helper, host or ex-partner it relies on is paid to betray it, so the attacker must buy silence from all of them each epoch, and one defection loses the whole pearl string of stakes.
